verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an NFC-branded Nitrokey 3 model with FIDO2 and passwordless login, plus a docs section titled 'Android / NitroPhone'. That suggests the key can be tapped on a phone, but no item explicitly documents NFC authentication in mobile browsers or apps. missing for 10: explicit documentation of NFC tap-to-authenticate on phones, confirmation that mobile browsers and apps (Android/iOS) are supported, hands-on or independent corroboration of NFC use on mobile.

support.subject: As a power user, I can tap the key on my phone over NFC to authenticate in mobile browsers and apps

citations.quote: The Nitrokey 3 combines the features of previous Nitrokey models: FIDO2, one-time passwords
